風險管理                    RISK MANAGEMENT
有效的風險管理是本集團達致戰略目標的基本及   Effective risk management is the basic and necessary factor for achieving strategic
必要保障，為此本集團已制定《龍湖集團風險管   goals of the Group. As such, the Group has established the Risk Management
理制度》。制度中明確了本集團風險管理組織體   System of Longfor Group, which specifies the Group’s risk management
系及具體職責、風險管理整體流程、風險評估方   organizational system, detailed responsibility, overall procedures of risk
法，以及定期的風險報告機制。          management, risk assessment method and regular risk reporting mechanism.

風險管理組織體系：龍湖集團的風險管理組織體   Risk management organizational system: The risk management organizational
系是董事會領導下的三道基本防線，即公司業務   system of Longfor Group consists of three basic lines of defense under the
職能部門的管理層和員工為第一道防線；由集團   leadership of the Board, namely the management and staff of business
職能負責人組成的，首席執行官為組長、首席財   departments as the first line of defense; the risk management team consisting
務官為副組長的風險管理小組為第二道防線；    of the general manager of business departments of the Group with the CEO as
審核委員會和內審中心為第三道防線。董事會是   team leader and CFO as deputy team leader as the second line of defense; and
風險管理的最終責任機構，有權對集團風險管理   the Audit Committee and internal audit centre as the third line of defense. The
的政策制度及應對方案進行指引和最終決策，評   Board shall be the ultimate accountability body of risk management, and shall
估集團風險偏好，把握在戰略目標實現及風險管   have the right to provide guidance and make final decisions on the policy, system
理之間的匹配度；審核委員會和內審中心由董事   and responding plan of risk management of the Group, conduct assessment on
會委派，對公司風險管理的實施情況進行指導監   the risk appetite of the Group and control the balance between the realization of
控，並審閱年度風險管理報告；風險管理小組負   strategic goals and risk management. The Audit Committee and internal audit
責不斷完善風險管理體系，執行包括風險識別、   centre are authorized by the Board to advise on and monitor the implementation
評估、應對方案以及風險管理報告的管理流程，   of risk management of the Group and review the annual risk management report.
包括年度更新風險庫，對應對方案實施進行跟蹤   The risk management team is responsible for the ongoing improvement of risk
監控，編製並匯報風險管理報告。業務部門是風   management system as well as the implementation of management procedures
險所有者，對各自的風險領域實施管理與監控。   including risk identification, assessment, responding plan and risk management

限制性股份激勵計劃                         RESTRICTED SHARE AWARD SCHEME
本公司已經採用限制性股份激勵計劃，計劃目的             To provide long-term incentive for employees, assist to retain its existing
為僱員提供長期激勵，協助本集團保留其現有僱             employees and attract more talents, and provide human resources protection for
員及吸引更多優秀人才，為本集團的長期戰略目             the long-term strategic goals of the Group, the Company has adopted a restricted
標提供人力資源保障。根據此計劃，受託人將以             share award scheme. According to the share award scheme, trustee can purchase
本公司提供的現金於市場上購買現有股份，並以             shares from the market out of cash contributed by the Group. The shares are held
信託形式代相關選定僱員持有，直至該等股份按             in trust for the relevant selected employees until such shares are vested.
計劃規則歸屬予相關選定僱員為止。

           於二零二一年六月，委員會透過其              In June 2021, the Committee, through its agenda decision, clarified
           議程決定澄清實體於釐定存貨的可              the costs an entity should include as “estimated costs necessary
           變現淨值時將成本計入「銷售必要              to make the sale” when determining the net realisable value of
           的估計成本」。特別是，此類成本              inventories. In particular, whether such costs should be limited to
           是否應僅限於銷售增量的成本。委              those that are incremental to the sale. The Committee concluded
           員會認為，銷售必要的估計成本不              that the estimated costs necessary to make the sale should not be
           應限於增量成本，亦應包括實體出              limited to those that are incremental but should also include costs
           售其存貨必須承擔的成本，包括非              that an entity must incur to sell its inventories including those that
           特定銷售增量的成本。                   are not incremental to a particular sale.

           本集團於委員會議程決定前的會計              The Group’s accounting policy prior to the Committee’s agenda
           政策僅考慮增量成本釐定存貨的可              decision was to determine the net realisable value of inventories
           變現淨值。應用委員會議程決定               taking into consideration incremental costs only. Upon application
           後，本集團更改其會計政策，於釐              of the Committee’s agenda decision, the Group changed its
           定存貨的可變現淨值時將存貨銷售              accounting policy to determine the net realisable value of
           的必要增量成本及其他成本均考慮              inventories taking into consideration both incremental costs and
           在內。新會計政策已追溯應用。               other cost necessary to sell inventories including sales staff salaries.
                                        The new accounting policy has been applied retrospectively.

            根據中國的相關法律及法規，本公司的中                                According to the relevant laws and regulations in the PRC, the Company’s
            國附屬公司須參加由地方市政府管理的界                                PRC subsidiaries are required to participate in a defined contribution
            定供款退休計劃。本公司的中國附屬公司                                retirement scheme administered by the local municipal government.
            向該計劃供款以撥款予僱員退休福利，該                                The Company’s PRC subsidiaries contribute funds which are calculated
            供款根據經地方市政府同意的按僱員平均                                on certain percentage of the average employee salary as agreed by local
            薪金的若干百分比計算。本集團就有關退                                municipal government to the scheme to fund the retirement benefits of
            休福利計劃的主要責任為根據該計劃作出                                the employees. The principal obligation of the Group with respect to the
            規定供款。                                             retirement benefit scheme is to make the required contributions under the
                                                              scheme.

            本集團亦為其所有香港合資格僱員設立強                                The Group also operates a Mandatory Provident Fund Scheme for all
            制性公積金計劃。計劃的資產與本集團                                 qualifying employees in Hong Kong. The assets of the scheme are held
            的資產分開持有，存置於受託人管理的基                                separately from those of the Group, in funds under the control of trustee.
            金。本集團按相關薪金成本的5%向該計                                The Group contributes 5% of relevant payroll costs to the scheme and the
            劃供款，而僱員按相同金額供款。                                   same amount is matched by employees.

  本集團管理資本以確保本集團的實體能持                The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will
  續經營，同時透過優化債務及股本結餘為                be able to continue as a going concern while maximising the return to
  股東帶來最大回報。                         shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.

  本集團的資本結構包括債務淨額（包括                 The capital structure of the Group consists of net debt, which includes,
  分別於附註30及31披露的借款及優先票               where appropriate, the borrowings and senior notes disclosed in notes
  據）、現金及現金等價物淨額以及本公司                30 and 31 respectively, net of cash and cash equivalents and equity
  擁有人應佔權益（包括已發行股本、儲備                attributable to owners of the Company, comprising issued share capital,
  及保留盈利）。                           reserves and retained earnings.

  本公司董事定期審閱資本架構。作為該審                The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a regular
  閱的一部分，本公司董事考慮資本成本及                basis. As part of this review, the directors of the Company consider the
  與各類資本有關的風險，並採取適當措施                cost of capital and the risks associated with each class of capital, and take
  平衡整體資本架構。                         appropriate actions to balance its overall capital structure.
